definitions.explanation: The physical or wireless connection used to access the internet. Refers to both the infrastructure (fiber, cable, etc.) and the connection itself.

examples.japanese: ネット{回線|かいせん}が{遅|おそ}い。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}でネット{回線|かいせん}を{契約|けいやく}した。
examples.english: I signed up for internet service at the new place.

examples.japanese: {光|ひかり}のネット{回線|かいせん}に{変|か}えてから、{動画|どうが}がスムーズに{見|み}られるようになった。
examples.english: After switching to a fiber internet connection, I can watch videos smoothly.

notes:
FORMS:
ネット (internet, from English "net") + {回線|かいせん} (line, circuit)

TYPES OF CONNECTIONS:
- {光回線|ひかりかいせん}: fiber-optic connection
- モバイル{回線|かいせん}: mobile/cellular connection
- Wi-Fi{回線|かいせん}: Wi-Fi connection

USAGE:
A common everyday term in Japan, especially when moving to a new apartment (setting up internet) or troubleshooting connection problems. Internet service in Japan typically requires contracting both a {回線|かいせん} (line) and a プロバイダ (ISP/provider) separately, though bundled plans exist.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ネット{回線|かいせん}を{契約|けいやく}する: to sign up for internet
- ネット{回線|かいせん}が{遅|おそ}い/{速|はや}い: internet is slow/fast
- ネット{回線|かいせん}が{不安定|ふあんてい}: unstable internet connection
- ネット{回線|かいせん}の{工事|こうじ}: internet installation work
